entries.establishes: That Axcelis publishes a single ion-implantation platform, Purion, in high-current, mid-current, medium-energy and high-energy variants sharing a common architecture with three beamline technologies, and that Axcelis states a throughput figure of up to 500 wafers per hour for it.
entries.doesNotEstablish: The throughput figure is the company's own published number, not a measured or independently verified one. The page carries no yield, reliability or availability data, no comparison with any other supplier, and no publication date, so it cannot establish current product availability or that any figure was achieved in production.

entries.establishes: That DISCO publishes equipment lines for dicing, laser dicing, grinding, polishing, wafer mounting, inspection, die separation, surface planing and waterjet cutting, organised around cutting, grinding and polishing processes.
entries.doesNotEstablish: The page carries no throughput, yield or reliability figures, no comparison with any other supplier, and no publication date. It establishes what DISCO lists, not how any machine performs or whether any line is currently available.
